subject: Urgent: Lumen Health runtime incident — customer updates & exec briefing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-18T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: SEV1 — Lumen Health: sustained latency / request failures on inference cluster

Folks,

We have a SEV1 impacting Lumen Health (prod-us-west) — sustained elevated tail latency and ~18% 5xx rate for the last 9 minutes. Early signs point to a degraded GPU node pool causing long queue times; autoscaler is not triggering additional capacity for this workload.

Immediate asks:
- Open an incident bridge: I will host at https://redwood.bridge/4127 in 5 minutes.
- Priyom/Jonas: please send a short customer acknowledgement within 15 minutes with a bridge link and SLA exposure note.
- Rishi: can you confirm whether recent kernel changes (deployed 02/17) are on the serving path for Lumen?
- Marissa: prep the standard customer-facing status template; we should include ETA for next update (t+60m).

I will collect diagnostics (dmesg, kubectl describe, runtime logs) and paste a log snippet to the bridge.

Soojin
SRE — Redwood Inference

Attachments: bridge-log-snippet.txt (extracted tail of runtime log)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lumen Health Ops <ops@lumenhealth.com>, Anya Patel <anya.patel@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-18T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Service interruption — joining bridge (Lumen Health)

Hi Anya / Lumen Ops,

We're aware of the disruption and have a dedicated incident team working on it. Bridge is live: https://redwood.bridge/4127 (Soojin is the bridge lead).

What to expect in the next hour:
- 09:30 PT: initial triage summary + impact estimate
- 10:00 PT: customer-facing update with mitigation steps and ETA
- We will escalate to an exec update if we cannot restore service by +4 hours.

We apologize for the disruption — we understand the downstream impact for your clinical workflows. We'll keep updates brief and actionable.

Points of contact: Jonas Weber (Account Lead) — jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173

-Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-02-18T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: (internal) Quick triage — autoscaler + CUDA kernel correlation

Triage notes from the bridge:
- Autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts but nodes fail readiness checks; kubelet reports OOMKill on the inference process on 3 of 12 nodes.
- Runtime logs (attached) show a kernel-level CUDA allocation timeout pattern that started ~02/17 23:10 PT — correlates with Rishi's kernel rollout.
- Workaround trial: manually cordon and drain one affected host; staging workloads recover but prod still exhibits queuing.

Action items:
1) Rishi: revert latest kernel change on a single canary host and verify alloc behavior (ETA 30m).
2) Marissa/Priyom: prepare the customer update (we should be explicit about what we know vs. what we are investigating).
3) Soojin: continue log collection and push sanitized snippets to Drive.

Attaching: bridge-log-snippet.txt, lumen-status-timeline.csv

Soojin

Subject: Lumen Health — interim status (12:30 PT)

Hi Anya / team,

Status update: we have identified a likely root cause candidate (GPU-host-level allocation failures tied to a kernel change deployed yesterday). Our engineers are executing a controlled rollback and targeted host drains now.

Impact: intermittent elevated latency and request failures for a subset of your traffic (~10–20% of requests routed to affected hosts). We are routing burst traffic away and limiting long-running requests as a stopgap.

Next update: 13:30 PT or earlier if there is a material change.

Committed items for customers:
- We will provide a post-incident summary within 48 hours with RCA and timelines for mitigations.
- We will offer a one-time credit for any SLA breaches during this window; your account team will follow up with details.

Thanks for your patience — please use the bridge for live Q&A.

Best,
Jonas

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Patel <anya.patel@lumenhealth.com>, Lumen Health Ops <ops@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-18T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Lumen Health — executive update and next steps (service impact brief)

Anya / Lumen leadership,

I wanted to provide an executive summary of the service impact we're currently addressing and our near-term commitments.

What happened: between 23:10 PT on 02/17 and 12:15 PT on 02/18, a subset of GPU hosts experienced repeated CUDA allocation failures after a kernel update. This resulted in increased tail latency and a temporary rise in 5xx responses for approximately 10–20% of your requests routed to those hosts.

What we did: our SRE and engineering teams identified the pattern, executed a targeted rollback on a canary host, and drained affected hosts. Traffic routing and temporary request limiting were applied to reduce customer impact.

Current status: remediation is in progress; we are seeing reduced error rates on canary hosts and incremental recovery as drains complete. Full restoration timeline: we expect stabilization within 6 hours from now barring further regression; we will confirm earlier if we reach steady-state sooner.

Customer-facing commitments:
- 48-hour RCA with timeline, impact quantification, and action owner list (delivered by 02/20 16:45 PT).
- One-time credit for SLA breach during the impacted window; account team will follow up with the proposed credit and process.
- Weekly updates on mitigation progress until permanent fixes are deployed.

Attachments / artifacts: bridge logs and a short timeline (available here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B-lumen-incident-20270218).

If you'd like a short exec call to walk through the timeline, Jonas and I are available this evening.

Sincerely,
Priyom Das
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0191
